content: Frodo is a unified TikTok SaaS platform that consolidates 5 TikTok platforms (Shop, Developer, Marketing, LIVE, Research) into one dashboard for agencies. Tech stack: Python 3.12 FastAPI backend, Next.js 15 frontend, PostgreSQL 16 with multi-tenant JSONB, Redis 7 for cache/broker, Celery 5 for background tasks, Node.js Fastify sidecar for TikTok Shop HMAC signing. Architecture: 11 domain modules following routes/services/schemas pattern, unified TikTok gateway facade with rate limiter + circuit breaker + retry middleware chain, JWT auth with 5-tier RBAC, AES-256-GCM token vault, WebSocket real-time via Redis pub/sub.

TikTok platform integration details: 1) Shop API (open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com) - HMAC-SHA256 auth via Node SDK sidecar at port 4000, 7d access tokens, 201 operations across 18 domains. 2) Developer API (open.tiktokapis.com) - OAuth 2.0 Bearer, 24h access + 365d refresh tokens. 3) Marketing API (business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/) - OAuth 2.0 long-term tokens + SDK adapter, largest API surface with hundreds of endpoints. 4) Research API (open.tiktokapis.com/v2/research) - Client credentials OAuth. 5) LIVE - WebSocket via TikTokLive library, no auth (public streams). Each platform has separate auth, no cross-authentication. All currently mock-tested, 0 real API calls made.

Backend module pattern in backend/modules/: Each of 11 modules follows routes/ (FastAPI routers) + services/ (business logic) + schemas.py (Pydantic models) + optional webhook_handlers.py. Modules: connect (OAuth flows), commerce (orders/products/shops/fulfillment/returns), advertising (campaigns/ad groups/ads/reports), content (videos/publishing/calendar), creators (discovery/campaigns/Spark Ads), intelligence (trends/competitors/Research API), live (LIVE commerce/WebSocket), messaging (customer messaging), organic (organic mentions), analytics (unified KPIs/reports), webhooks (webhook processing). Cross-module bridges: content_creator_bridge.py links content and creators for Spark Ads. Unified services aggregate cross-platform data for commerce and advertising.

Auth and multi-tenancy: JWT HS256 with 15min access / 7d refresh tokens in HttpOnly cookies. Claims include user_id, organization_id, role. 5-tier RBAC: owner > admin > manager > member > viewer. Social login via TikTok and Google OAuth. Hierarchy: Organization -> Workspace -> Membership. All tenant-scoped tables have workspace_id column. Token security: AES-256-GCM encryption in TokenVault model. Auto-refresh via Celery Beat: Shop every 24h, Developer every 12h, Marketing daily health check. Dependencies: CurrentUser, DBSession, get_workspace_id in backend/dependencies.py.

Background task system: Celery 5 with Redis broker. Config in backend/workers/celery_app.py with 20 periodic beat schedules. Worker modules: token_refresh (auto-rotate platform tokens), webhook_processor (handle incoming webhooks), data_sync (general data sync), ad_sync (advertising campaigns/reports), content_sync (videos/publishing status), creator_sync (creator marketplace data), analytics_sync (unified metrics aggregation), intelligence_sync (trends/competitors), live_sync (LIVE session data), messaging_sync (customer messages). Each worker follows async pattern with error handling and retry logic. Docker setup: separate celery-worker and celery-beat containers.

Frontend: Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, Tailwind v4, TypeScript. Structure: app/(auth)/ for login/register/OAuth callbacks, app/(dashboard)/ with 13 sections (ads, commerce, content, creators, analytics, etc). Component libraries: components/dashboard/ (domain-specific), components/landing/ (marketing), components/ui/ (13+ reusable components with barrel export). Key files: lib/api.ts (1500-line typed API client), lib/auth.ts (auth helpers), config/navigation.ts (14 sidebar items). Design system: 3-zone Performance Cockpit layout (MetricBar top, Main Content center, InsightPanel right). Hooks: useCommerceWebSocket, useSyncWebSocket, usePlatformFilter, workspace context. PlatformTabLayout shared component for platform->feature->content navigation. Toast system via useSyncExternalStore pattern.

Production readiness status: Pre-production, 0/79 production items completed. All 11 modules code-complete but mock-tested only. 879 tests (842 unit + 37 integration), 0 e2e tests. No cloud infrastructure exists. No TikTok app registration done (critical path). No staging environment. Key gaps: real API validation, error handling for production edge cases, monitoring/logging infrastructure, CI/CD pipeline, secrets management, rate limit tuning with real traffic, database connection pooling for production load. Local dev: PostgreSQL 17 via Homebrew, Redis 7 via Homebrew, no Docker installed. Test user: e2etest@example.com / TestPass123!

TikTok Shop SDK Sidecar: Node.js 20 + Fastify service running at port 4000. Uses official TikTok Shop Node.js SDK for HMAC-SHA256 signing. Exposes POST /api/shop/proxy endpoint that Python backend calls via TikTokShopSDKClient (httpx). Covers 201 operations across 18 Shop domains. The sidecar handles all cryptographic signing that would be complex to reimplement in Python. Located at tiktok-shop-sdk/src/. Start: cd tiktok-shop-sdk && npm ci && npm run build && npm run dev. Override env: TIKTOK_SHOP_SDK_URL=http://localhost:4000 (default .env has Docker hostname).

TikTok Gateway pattern: backend/tiktok/gateway.py is the unified facade for all 5 platforms. Platform-specific clients in: shop/ (with sdk_client.py for sidecar proxy), developer/, marketing/, live/, research/. Middleware chain: Rate Limiter (Redis token bucket per platform) -> Circuit Breaker (configurable failure threshold, open/half-open/closed states) -> Retry (exponential backoff, 3 attempts max). Each platform client implements a common interface. The gateway routes requests to the appropriate platform client based on the operation type. Rate limits are per-platform and per-workspace to prevent one tenant from exhausting another's quota.

Development commands: Backend: python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -e ".[dev]" && uvicorn backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload. Frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev (port 3000). Sidecar: cd tiktok-shop-sdk && npm ci && npm run build && npm run dev (port 4000). DB: docker compose up -d postgres redis && alembic upgrade head. Tests: pytest (879 total), pytest -m unit (842), pytest -m integration (37), pytest --cov=backend --cov-report=term-missing. Quality: ruff format backend/ tests/, ruff check backend/ tests/ --fix, mypy backend/, bandit -r backend/. Start order: sidecar -> backend -> frontend. Local dev uses Homebrew PostgreSQL 17 + Redis 7, NOT Docker.

Key files map: backend/main.py (app factory, router registration, middleware stack), backend/config.py (all env vars via pydantic-settings BaseSettings), backend/dependencies.py (FastAPI DI: CurrentUser, DBSession, get_workspace_id), backend/db/models/base.py (SQLAlchemy base + common mixins), backend/tiktok/gateway.py (unified TikTok API facade), backend/workers/celery_app.py (Celery config + 20 beat schedules), frontend/src/lib/api.ts (1500-line typed API client), frontend/src/lib/auth.ts (auth helpers + token management), frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx (auth guard + workspace context provider), frontend/src/config/navigation.ts (sidebar nav config with 14 items), tiktok-shop-sdk/src/ (Fastify sidecar for Shop HMAC signing). DB models: backend/db/models/ has 16-18 model files with 120 entity classes.

Coding conventions: Python PEP 8, type annotations everywhere, ruff format + lint, mypy strict. Git: conventional commits (feat|fix|refactor|docs|test|chore|perf|ci: description). Tests: pytest with markers (unit/integration/e2e), target 80%+ coverage. New modules: follow routes/ + services/ + schemas.py pattern. Frontend: Tailwind utility classes via cn(), component libs in components/ui/. No secrets in code: use .env + backend/config.py (pydantic-settings). All user-facing strings use | t filter in Liquid. Frontend components use barrel exports from components/ui/index.ts.

Full-stack development swarm (frodo-fullstack-dev): Hierarchical topology, queen-led, 7 agents. Queen (opus/coordinator) routes to: backend-dev (sonnet/coder, Python/FastAPI), frontend-dev (sonnet/coder, Next.js/React), tiktok-specialist (sonnet/coder, 5 platform APIs), tester (sonnet/tester, pytest 879 tests), security (opus/security-architect, JWT/RBAC/token vault), reviewer (sonnet/reviewer, code quality). Use for feature development, bug fixes, and module creation. Swarm ID: swarm-1774810591169-dsmlmf

TikTok API Integration swarm config: Mesh topology, 5 agents. Agents: api-researcher (opus, reads knowledge-base/ docs), platform-integrator (sonnet, implements client code in backend/tiktok/), gateway-engineer (sonnet, rate limiter + circuit breaker + retry tuning), integration-tester (sonnet, writes @pytest.mark.integration tests), security-auditor (opus, validates token flows + encryption). Use when connecting to real TikTok API endpoints. Workflow: frodo-tiktok-api-integration.

Testing Blitz swarm config: Mesh topology, 4 agents. Agents: coverage-analyst (sonnet, runs pytest --cov, identifies gaps), unit-test-writer (sonnet, writes @pytest.mark.unit tests), integration-test-writer (sonnet, writes @pytest.mark.integration tests), edge-case-hunter (sonnet, tests error paths, rate limits, circuit breaker trips, malformed responses). Target: 80%+ coverage. Currently 879 tests (842 unit + 37 integration). Workflow: frodo-testing-blitz.

Production Hardening swarm config: Hierarchical topology, 6 agents. Queen: hardening-lead (opus, tracks 79 production items). Workers: security-hardener (opus, auth/RBAC/secrets/CORS), performance-optimizer (sonnet, DB pooling/caching/N+1 queries), observability-engineer (sonnet, logging/health checks/metrics), deployment-engineer (sonnet, Docker optimization/CI-CD/env configs), final-validator (sonnet, runs full test+lint+type+security suite). 0/79 items currently done. Workflow: frodo-production-hardening.

Code Review swarm config: Star topology (reviewer at center), 4 agents. Hub: lead-reviewer (opus, synthesizes findings). Spokes: security-reviewer (sonnet, OWASP/auth/injection), quality-reviewer (sonnet, conventions/patterns/performance), test-reviewer (sonnet, coverage/assertions/edge cases). Use for pre-merge PR reviews. Each reviewer focuses on their domain, lead-reviewer aggregates into single report with CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW findings.

Security and reliability audit conducted 2026-03-29. Found and fixed 44 issues (6 CRITICAL, 14 HIGH, 24 MEDIUM). CRITICAL fixes: (1) Workspace authorization bypass in dependencies.py — added workspace existence check and org_id validation, (2) Rate limiter race condition — replaced two-pipeline read-write with atomic Lua script + fail-open on Redis errors, (3) Circuit breaker race conditions — added asyncio.Lock for all state mutations, (4) Circuit breaker shared across tenants — replaced per-platform dict with CircuitBreakerRegistry keyed by (platform, account_id), (5) Circuit breaker half-open probe — only allows one probe request at a time, (6) SDK sidecar auth hook — added missing early return after 401. HIGH fixes: retry logic now has jitter + 15s total timeout, Membership table has indexes on user_id/org_id/workspace_id, Research client tracks token expiration + auto-refreshes, Developer client detects 401 + raises TokenExpiredError, LIVE client has reconnection with exponential backoff + 5min timeout. Tests: 998 passing (up from 879).
